senses.gloss:
रञ्ज् (औ, ञ) रजति, ते 1.
a. To dye,
to tinge; to be attached. (ञ, य)
रज्यति, ते 4.
c. To dye. With अनु
to be attached to; with अप or
वि to be disgusted with.

रञ्जक (कः) 1.
m. Colouring; a co-
lourist; a stimulus^1; bile.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

रञ्जन (नः-नं) 1.
m. n. Idem; affec-
ting the heart.
f. (नी) Indigo
plant; Nyctanthes tristis; Ben-
gal madder.
n. Red sandal wood.
